exact_result: Unverified new special-case theorem: for EACH fixed continuous real-coefficient actual-PC positive-at-infinity reference on finite rational spatial domains on a product of two nonempty finite embedded balanced rational pure1D graphs with actual saturated lattices, arbitrary positive real edge weights and rank-one strictly positive local relation cones, every bounded continuous real-PA rational-domain obstacle has an actual rational-domain PAPC uniformly decreasing regularizable raw envelope and complete contact iff at least one graph factor is unbranched. If both branch, every prescribed real reference has a nonnegative compactly supported bounded real-PA rational-domain obstacle, unchanged reference at infinity, exact actual PAPC raw envelope P, and full contact integral -8*epsilon^2*a*b<0. All valences, bounded edges, cycles, ends, full lines and disconnected components are retained.
concrete_gaps: Original P05.2 fixed-pair characterization on arbitrary balanced rational polyhedral spaces remains open; this proof treats only the specified finite two-graph product subclass.
No classification is supplied for other higher-dimensional carriers, additional product factors, or the catalogue's combined intrinsic smoothness/strict-positivity contact package.
No literal integral-slope or analytic realization result is claimed. The new theorem is an unverified proof draft; arithmetic, author audit and compilation do not formally verify it.
